ResearchProjectDef.label: biological cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to cultivate stable living materials, controlled regenerative tissues and the first deliberately grown technological organs. Requires analysis of recovered Wraith living technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith feeding ecology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organise feeding reserves, Keeper-supervised ration feeding and long-cycle dormancy into a stable life-force economy. Unlocks feeding niches and the biological support doctrine needed for large Wraith populations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vital resistance therapy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineer the physiological failure modes of Wraith feeding and deliberately provoke them in a treated human body. Unlocks a costly experimental resistance dose that greatly reduces life-force extraction for several days, but causes treatment strain and can trigger an acute rejection crisis when feeding is attempted.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioelectric organs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow organs that generate, transmit and store electrical power for ordinary colony power networks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: living weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow purpose-designed ranged organisms capable of stunning prey or delivering lethal bioelectrical attacks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced carapace cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow layered protective carapaces for elite Wraith warriors and command castes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith cloning infrastructure
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow stable population-scale cloning organs. A mature Growth Chamber can gestate Hunters, Warriors and Keepers by consuming cultured biomass and a measured life-force contribution from an existing Wraith under Keeper or Queen supervision.

ResearchProjectDef.label: forbidden wraith-human hybridisation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine Wraith cloning knowledge with research into human resistance to life-force extraction and force an incomplete Wraith genome to coexist with a living human subject. Unlocks a Growth Chamber procedure that mutates the exact subject in place rather than replacing them. The resulting hybrid retains ordinary nutrition, receives only limited Wraith abilities and suffers recurring biological and psychic instability.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mature wraith hive architecture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Integrate feeding ecology, cloning, bioelectric circulation and regenerative tissue into population-scale Hive infrastructure. Unlocks metabolic hearts that consume cultured biomass to repair damaged living structures and provides the biological systems needed to sustain mature Wraith sites and large organic craft.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith organic gravtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extend mature Hive circulation into living hull tissue, cultivated controls, gravitic power and propulsion. Unlocks Wraith-themed Odyssey gravships, their shipborne metabolic heart, and construction of the independent Wraith Dart shuttlecraft.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanite analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Understand the coordinated microscopic machine systems used by human-form nanite beings and Asuran devices. Requires analysis of recovered Asuran field technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct stable high-precision Asuran fabrication systems and reproduce advanced field equipment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran energy systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop compact high-density power cells, gravitic power cores and efficient energy weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran shields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Project stable defensive fields suitable for settlements and themed Odyssey gravships.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran gravtech and shuttle systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Apply Asuran controls, efficient power, shielding and vector thrust to Odyssey gravships while unlocking the independent Puddle Jumper shuttlecraft for transport and scouting.

ResearchProjectDef.label: replicator study
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the modular architecture and replication logic of small autonomous Replicators. Requires analysis of recovered Replicator matter.

ResearchProjectDef.label: controlled replicator gestation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gestate player-controlled Replicators without enabling their autonomous colony-consuming swarm behaviour.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanite containment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop practical containment doctrine, EMP disruption and anti-replication procedures for uncontrolled nanite and Replicator systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced nanite suppression
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine repeated EMP disruption into controlled anti-Replicator suppression. Powered suppressors can interrupt active block-Replicator assimilation and recombination, temporarily sever mature-swarm controller coordination, and trigger the existing EMP reconstruction shutdown in human-form nanite beings without turning the countermeasure into a map-wide instant kill.
